name: Ara
source:
Kind and caring, Ara is not only determined to make your time in Limbo a happy thing to remember, but also to make things go back to the way they were, no matter the cost. Her dazzling smile hides an ambition and a determination that could serve you well—if both your goals are as aligned as she swears them to be.

[From [url=https://ravenstar-games.itch.io/lost-in-limbo]itch.io[/url]]
